full_prompt_en: A square high contrast anime poster shows a masked young leader lunging toward the viewer with two allies behind him. The main figure fills the front center and left, wearing a black coat, dark gloves, and a sharp white eye mask. Tousled black hair sweeps over his forehead, and one pale eye looks forward with a confident half smile. His right arm reaches toward the viewer, the black gloved hand enlarged by perspective; his other arm and coat form long slanting shapes across the lower right. Behind his shoulder at the upper right, a dark haired woman in black turns her face toward the viewer, pale skin and fine eyes emerging from shadow. A smaller companion appears at the far left edge, partly cropped but still recognizable as another pale faced black clad figure. The background is almost entirely black and white, cut by aggressive crimson bands, scratches, and splattered halftone marks. Thick diagonal streaks cross behind the group from upper left toward lower right, echoing the main figure's forward motion. White highlights carve the jacket folds, mask, hair strands, and hands out of the deep ink black. There is no visible room or landscape; the scene is designed as a concentrated graphic impact. Light is stark and frontal from the upper left, leaving wide black regions and narrow bright planes. The composition feels fast, rebellious, and stylish, using layered faces, foreshortened movement, and a restricted red black white palette.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形高对比动画海报描绘一名戴面具的年轻主角带着两位同伴朝观者冲来。主角占据前方中央与左侧，穿黑外套、戴深手套和锐利白色眼罩。凌乱黑发扫过额头，一只浅色眼睛带自信半笑向前看。右臂伸向观者，黑手套因透视而放大；另一只手和外套在右下形成修长斜线。肩后右上，一名穿黑衣的深发女子把脸转向观者，浅色皮肤和细眼从阴影里浮出。更小同伴出现在最左边缘，虽被部分裁切，仍可辨为另一名浅脸黑衣人物。背景几乎全由黑白组成，被激烈深红色带、刮痕和溅散半调点切开。厚斜线从左上穿到右下，呼应主角前冲运动。白高光把外套褶、眼罩、发丝和手从浓黑墨色里刻出。没有可见房间或风景；场景被设计成集中的图形冲击。光从左上强烈正面照来，留下大片黑区和窄亮平面。构图快速、叛逆而时髦，层叠面孔、透视缩短的运动和受限红黑白色域共同驱动。
style_prompt_en: High contrast anime poster design combines solid ink black, exposed white, and aggressive saturated crimson. Several overlapping focal shapes step backward through the frame while a large near diagonal projects outward. Sharp angular outlines and white cutout highlights make dark forms legible without gray modeling. Red slash marks, scraped streaks, and halftone speckle energize the background, crossing behind the central grouping at a forceful angle. Detail is concentrated in narrow focal features, then collapses quickly into broad shadow. Stark upper side light strengthens the white edges, but the largest masses remain flat and graphic. The composition feels fast, stylish, and defiant, with motion generated by foreshortening, overlap, and repeated slashing lines.
style_prompt_zh: 高对比动画海报设计结合实墨黑、露白和激烈饱和深红。数块重叠焦点形体在画框中逐级后退，一道大型近景斜线向外伸。锐利棱角轮廓和白色挖空高光使深色形体无需灰阶塑造也可辨。红色斩痕、刮擦条痕和半调小点使背景活跃，以强斜角穿过中央形体群后方。细节聚在窄小焦点特征，随后迅速塌入宽阔阴影。上方侧光强化白边，但最大体块仍平涂且图形化。构图快速、时髦而叛逆，透视缩短、重叠和重复斩线共同产生动势。
theme_en: Masked black clad leader lunging forward with two allies in a red graphic scene
theme_zh: 蒙面黑衣主角带着两名同伴冲向画面前方的红色图形场景
name: Persona 5 Strikers
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
